name: FR Y-9C Schedule HC to HC-R Capital Chain
outcome: Gated two-step chain for top-tier bank holding companies (Y-9C panel, total consolidated assets >= $3B). Step 1 maps caller-declared Schedule HC balance-sheet line items into Schedule HC totals and checks the balance-sheet identity. Step 2 consumes those totals alongside caller-supplied capital components to compute Schedule HC-R capital ratios and the supplementary leverage ratio, gated dual_control(2) before the capital-adequacy result is treated as final -- any failed capital-ratio or SLR threshold requires two distinct approver sign-offs (recorded, not yet runtime-gated pending HA-RETRO-1 wiring).
